title: Astros+ Performance — NACL Div A 2026
description: Health, timeline, incidents, diagnosis and season trend for Astros+ in NACL Div A.

panels.title: Health · Summer 2026 (colour = rank out of 16: green top 5, red bottom 5)
League record
panels.description: League games only, plus how far the team went in the knockouts.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT league_won || ' won · ' || league_lost || ' lost  ·  ' || finish AS v
FROM cricket.team_summary WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND season = 'Summer 2026'

panels.title: Net run rate
panels.description: Runs per over scored minus runs per over conceded. An all-out side is charged 20 overs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT value || '  ·  ' || rank_label AS v FROM cricket.team_ranks WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND metric = 'Net run rate' AND season = 'Summer 2026'

panels.title: Batting run rate
panels.description: Runs per over across all innings batted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT value || '  ·  ' || rank_label AS v FROM cricket.team_ranks WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND metric = 'Run rate' AND season = 'Summer 2026'

panels.title: Bowling economy
panels.description: Runs conceded per over. Rank 1 = lowest.

targets.rawSql: SELECT value || '  ·  ' || rank_label AS v FROM cricket.team_ranks WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND metric = 'Economy' AND season = 'Summer 2026'

panels.title: Middle-over wickets lost
panels.description: Average wickets lost in the middle overs per innings. Rank 1 = fewest.

targets.rawSql: SELECT wickets_per_innings || '  ·  ' || cricket.ordinal(wickets_rank) || ' of 16' AS v FROM cricket.team_phase WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND side = 'batting' AND phase = 'middle' AND season = 'Summer 2026'

panels.title: Balls per 4 or 6
panels.description: Legal balls faced per 4 or 6. Rank 1 = most frequent boundaries.

targets.rawSql: SELECT value || '  ·  ' || rank_label AS v FROM cricket.team_ranks WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND metric = 'Balls per boundary' AND season = 'Summer 2026'

panels.title: Timeline & targets · every innings, Spring and Summer 2026
Run rate per match, Spring → Summer
panels.description: Every innings this year. The dashed step is the division's average run rate for that season: scoring jumped from 5.76 to 7.35 between the seasons.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT "time" + interval '12 hours' AS "time",
       run_rate_scored   AS "Runs per over scored",
       run_rate_conceded AS "Runs per over conceded",
       division_run_rate AS "Division average"
FROM cricket.innings_timeline WHERE team = 'Astros+' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Target: beat the division run rate
panels.description: Innings where our run rate was at or above that season's division average. Spring → Summer.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT max(count_beat) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Spring 2026') || '  →  ' ||
       max(count_beat) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Summer 2026') AS v
FROM (SELECT season, count(*) FILTER (WHERE beat_division_rate) || ' of ' || count(*) || ' innings' AS count_beat
      FROM cricket.innings_timeline WHERE team = 'Astros+' GROUP BY season) s

panels.title: Losses that included a batting collapse
panels.description: Collapse = 3 or more wickets inside 3 overs, before the last 3 overs. Spring → Summer.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT max(x) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Spring 2026') || '  →  ' || max(x) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Summer 2026') AS v
FROM (SELECT l.season, count(c.match_id) || ' of ' || count(*) AS x
      FROM cricket.match_log l
      LEFT JOIN cricket.collapses c ON c.match_id = l.match_id AND c.team = l.team
      WHERE l.team = 'Astros+' AND l.result = 'Lost' GROUP BY l.season) s

panels.title: Wickets down by over 15, per innings
panels.description: How many wickets were already gone after 15 overs. Above the dashed line = worse than the division average for that season.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t."time" + interval '12 hours' AS "time",
       t.wickets_by_over_15 AS "Wickets down by over 15",
       d.avg_w15 AS "Division average"
FROM cricket.innings_timeline t
JOIN (SELECT season, round(avg(wickets_by_over_15), 2) AS avg_w15
      FROM cricket.innings_timeline GROUP BY season) d USING (season)
WHERE t.team = 'Astros+' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Incident log: batting collapses
panels.description: 3 or more wickets inside any 3-over window, before the last 3 overs (overs 18-20 are treated as deliberate slogging). One row per innings: the worst window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(match_date, 'DD Mon') AS "Date", season AS "Season", opponent AS "Opponent",
       overs AS "Overs", wickets_in_window AS "Wickets", score_change AS "Score change",
       final_score AS "Final score", result AS "Result"
FROM cricket.collapses WHERE team = 'Astros+' ORDER BY match_date DESC

panels.title: Collapses per innings
panels.description: How often a collapse happens, against the division average.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (SELECT season, team, count(*) AS n FROM cricket.collapses GROUP BY 1, 2),
     i AS (SELECT season, team, count(*) AS inn FROM cricket.team_innings GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT i.season AS "Season",
       max(round(coalesce(c.n, 0)::numeric / i.inn, 2)) FILTER (WHERE i.team = 'Astros+') AS "Astros+",
       round(avg(coalesce(c.n, 0)::numeric / i.inn), 2) AS "Division average"
FROM i LEFT JOIN c USING (season, team)
GROUP BY i.season ORDER BY i.season DESC

options.content:
### What the season says

**1. Bowling is already semi-final standard.**
Economy 7.36 vs 7.48 for the 4 semi-finalists, and 8.7 wickets a match (4th of 16).
The middle overs are the best phase: economy 6.73, 4th of 16.

**2. The gap is the bat: about 21 runs an innings.**
We average 133; the semi-finalists average 154.
Run rate 7.12 vs 8.37, and a boundary every 6.9 balls vs 5.2.

**3. The runs go missing in all 3 phases.**
Powerplay 6.43 vs 7.77 · middle 7.24 vs 8.39 · death 7.94 vs 9.44.
We protect wickets early (4th fewest lost) but don't cash them in.

**4. Overs 7-15 are where innings break.**
4.2 wickets lost, 11th of 16 (semi-finalists lose 3.6).

**5. Leaking at both ends with the ball.**
Powerplay and death economy are both 12th of 16.

**6. Continuity.**
We used 26 batters across 9 games (13th of 16); the semi-finalists average 20.

**7. Run-outs:** 0.33 a match, 12th of 16 (semi-finalists 0.78).

<small>Source: CricClubs, NACL Summer 2026 Div A, all 68 matches. Ranks are out of 16 teams.</small>

panels.title: Where Astros+ ranks (out of 16) vs the semi-finalists
panels.description: Rank 1 = best in Div A for that metric. Green = top 5, red = bottom 5.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.category AS "Area", r.metric AS "Metric", r.value AS "Astros+", r.rank AS "Rank",
       r.top4_avg AS "Semi-finalists avg",
       r.league_avg AS "League avg", r.best_team || ' (' || r.best_value || ')' AS "Best in Div A"
FROM cricket.team_ranks r
WHERE r.team = 'Astros+' AND r.season = 'Summer 2026'
ORDER BY r.sort_order

panels.title: Batting run rate by phase
panels.description: Runs per over in each phase. Higher is better.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT initcap(p.phase) || CASE p.phase WHEN 'powerplay' THEN ' (1-6)' WHEN 'middle' THEN ' (7-15)' ELSE ' (16-20)' END AS phase,
       p.run_rate AS "Astros+",
       round(avg(q.run_rate) FILTER (WHERE s.top4), 2) AS "Semi-finalists",
       round(avg(q.run_rate), 2) AS "League average"
FROM cricket.team_phase p
JOIN cricket.team_phase q ON q.season = p.season AND q.side = p.side AND q.phase = p.phase
JOIN cricket.team_summary s ON s.season = q.season AND s.team = q.team
WHERE p.team = 'Astros+' AND p.side = 'batting' AND p.season = 'Summer 2026'
GROUP BY p.phase, p.phase_order, p.run_rate
ORDER BY p.phase_order

panels.title: Bowling economy by phase
panels.description: Runs conceded per over in each phase. Lower is better.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT initcap(p.phase) || CASE p.phase WHEN 'powerplay' THEN ' (1-6)' WHEN 'middle' THEN ' (7-15)' ELSE ' (16-20)' END AS phase,
       p.run_rate AS "Astros+",
       round(avg(q.run_rate) FILTER (WHERE s.top4), 2) AS "Semi-finalists",
       round(avg(q.run_rate), 2) AS "League average"
FROM cricket.team_phase p
JOIN cricket.team_phase q ON q.season = p.season AND q.side = p.side AND q.phase = p.phase
JOIN cricket.team_summary s ON s.season = q.season AND s.team = q.team
WHERE p.team = 'Astros+' AND p.side = 'bowling' AND p.season = 'Summer 2026'
GROUP BY p.phase, p.phase_order, p.run_rate
ORDER BY p.phase_order

panels.title: Wickets lost per innings, by phase
panels.description: Average wickets lost in each phase. Lower is better.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT initcap(p.phase) || CASE p.phase WHEN 'powerplay' THEN ' (1-6)' WHEN 'middle' THEN ' (7-15)' ELSE ' (16-20)' END AS phase,
       p.wickets_per_innings AS "Astros+",
       round(avg(q.wickets_per_innings) FILTER (WHERE s.top4), 2) AS "Semi-finalists",
       round(avg(q.wickets_per_innings), 2) AS "League average"
FROM cricket.team_phase p
JOIN cricket.team_phase q ON q.season = p.season AND q.side = p.side AND q.phase = p.phase
JOIN cricket.team_summary s ON s.season = q.season AND s.team = q.team
WHERE p.team = 'Astros+' AND p.side = 'batting' AND p.season = 'Summer 2026'
GROUP BY p.phase, p.phase_order, p.wickets_per_innings
ORDER BY p.phase_order

panels.title: Average score at the end of each over
panels.description: Cumulative runs, averaged over every innings that reached that over.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b.over_no AS "Over",
       max(b.avg_cum_runs) FILTER (WHERE b.team = 'Astros+') AS "Astros+",
       round(avg(b.avg_cum_runs) FILTER (WHERE s.top4), 1) AS "Semi-finalists",
       max(b.avg_cum_runs) FILTER (WHERE b.team = 'League average') AS "League average"
FROM cricket.over_baseline b
LEFT JOIN cricket.team_summary s ON s.season = b.season AND s.team = b.team
WHERE b.season = 'Summer 2026'
GROUP BY b.over_no ORDER BY b.over_no

panels.title: Quarter-final chase vs Money Heist (target 161): our run rate vs required rate
panels.description: Like an SLA chart: the required rate is the threshold, our run rate is the measurement. Bars show wickets down. Axis capped at 16: the required rate passes it in the last 2 overs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT over_no AS "Over", run_rate_so_far AS "Our run rate",
       required_rate_at_start_of_over AS "Required rate", cum_wickets AS "Wickets down"
FROM cricket.chase_progress
WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND stage = 'Quarter Final' AND season = 'Summer 2026'
ORDER BY over_no

SELECT to_char(match_date, 'Dy DD Mon') AS "Date", stage AS "Stage", opponent AS "Opponent", batting_order AS "Innings",
       score_for AS "Our score", score_against AS "Their score", result AS "Result", margin AS "Margin"
FROM cricket.match_log WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND season = 'Summer 2026' ORDER BY match_date

Finish
panels.description: How far Astros+ went: Spring 2026 → Summer 2026.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT max(finish) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Spring 2026') || '  →  ' || max(finish) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Summer 2026') AS v

panels.title: Division run rate (conditions)
panels.description: Average run rate across the whole division each season. Scoring rose sharply in Summer, so raw numbers are not comparable; ranks are.

targets.rawSql:

panels.description: Rank out of the division, Spring 2026 → Summer 2026.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT o.rank_label || '  →  ' || n.rank_label AS v
FROM cricket.team_ranks o JOIN cricket.team_ranks n USING (team, metric)
WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND metric = 'Run rate' AND o.season = 'Spring 2026' AND n.season = 'Summer 2026'

panels.title: Bowling economy rank
panels.description: Rank out of the division, Spring 2026 → Summer 2026. Rank 1 = lowest.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT o.rank_label || '  →  ' || n.rank_label AS v
FROM cricket.team_ranks o JOIN cricket.team_ranks n USING (team, metric)
WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND metric = 'Economy' AND o.season = 'Spring 2026' AND n.season = 'Summer 2026'

options.content:
### Spring → Summer: what changed

**1. The division scored a lot more in Summer.**
League run rate 5.76 → 7.35 (+28%); average score 104 → 133.
That is why this page compares ranks, not raw numbers.

**2. Our batting stood still while the league moved.**
Run rate 7.20 → 7.12 and average score 133 → 133.
That made us the best batting side in Spring (1st of 16) and 11th in Summer.

**3. The middle overs are the biggest change.**
Wickets lost in overs 7-15: 2.25 → 4.22 (1st → 11th).
Death-overs scoring fell too: 9.53 → 7.94 (1st → 11th).

**4. The bowling improved, relative to the division.**
Economy rank 15th → 8th, dot balls 16th → 5th, wickets per match 12th → 4th.

**5. Both knockout exits were chases that ended all out.**
Spring QF: 102 all out chasing 120. Summer QF: 133 all out chasing 161.
We were bowled out once in Spring and 4 times in Summer.

**6. More rotation.** Batters used: 22 → 26.

**7. Same result both times:** quarter-finalists (league 5-2 → 5-3).

<small>11 of the 16 Div A teams played both seasons. Spring excludes 5 matches with no result. Source: CricClubs.</small>

panels.title: Astros+ rank by metric: Spring 2026 vs Summer 2026
panels.description: Rank out of the division in each season (1 = best). 'Places moved' is positive when the rank improved.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT o.category AS "Area", o.metric AS "Metric",
       o.value AS "Spring", o.rank AS "Spring rank",
       n.value AS "Summer", n.rank AS "Summer rank",
       o.rank - n.rank AS "Places moved",
       n.top4_avg AS "Top 4 avg, Summer"
FROM cricket.team_ranks o JOIN cricket.team_ranks n USING (team, metric)
WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND o.season = 'Spring 2026' AND n.season = 'Summer 2026'
ORDER BY o.sort_order

panels.title: Batting run rate by phase
panels.description: Higher is better.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT initcap(p.phase) AS phase,
       max(p.run_rate) FILTER (WHERE p.season = 'Spring 2026' AND p.team = 'Astros+') AS "Astros+ Spring",
       max(p.run_rate) FILTER (WHERE p.season = 'Summer 2026' AND p.team = 'Astros+') AS "Astros+ Summer",
       round(avg(p.run_rate) FILTER (WHERE p.season = 'Summer 2026' AND s.top4), 2)  AS "Top 4, Summer"
FROM cricket.team_phase p
JOIN cricket.team_summary s ON s.season = p.season AND s.team = p.team
WHERE p.side = 'batting'
GROUP BY p.phase, p.phase_order ORDER BY p.phase_order

panels.title: Bowling economy by phase
panels.description: Lower is better.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT initcap(p.phase) AS phase,
       max(p.run_rate) FILTER (WHERE p.season = 'Spring 2026' AND p.team = 'Astros+') AS "Astros+ Spring",
       max(p.run_rate) FILTER (WHERE p.season = 'Summer 2026' AND p.team = 'Astros+') AS "Astros+ Summer",
       round(avg(p.run_rate) FILTER (WHERE p.season = 'Summer 2026' AND s.top4), 2)  AS "Top 4, Summer"
FROM cricket.team_phase p
JOIN cricket.team_summary s ON s.season = p.season AND s.team = p.team
WHERE p.side = 'bowling'
GROUP BY p.phase, p.phase_order ORDER BY p.phase_order

panels.title: Wickets lost per innings, by phase
panels.description: Lower is better.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT initcap(p.phase) AS phase,
       max(p.wickets_per_innings) FILTER (WHERE p.season = 'Spring 2026' AND p.team = 'Astros+') AS "Astros+ Spring",
       max(p.wickets_per_innings) FILTER (WHERE p.season = 'Summer 2026' AND p.team = 'Astros+') AS "Astros+ Summer",
       round(avg(p.wickets_per_innings) FILTER (WHERE p.season = 'Summer 2026' AND s.top4), 2)  AS "Top 4, Summer"
FROM cricket.team_phase p
JOIN cricket.team_summary s ON s.season = p.season AND s.team = p.team
WHERE p.side = 'batting'
GROUP BY p.phase, p.phase_order ORDER BY p.phase_order

panels.title: Average score at the end of each over
panels.description: Cumulative runs, averaged over every innings that reached that over. Dashed lines = division average.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT over_no AS "Over",
       max(avg_cum_runs) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Spring 2026' AND team = 'Astros+') AS "Astros+ Spring",
       max(avg_cum_runs) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Summer 2026' AND team = 'Astros+') AS "Astros+ Summer",
       max(avg_cum_runs) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Spring 2026' AND team = 'League average') AS "League avg Spring",
       max(avg_cum_runs) FILTER (WHERE season = 'Summer 2026' AND team = 'League average') AS "League avg Summer"
FROM cricket.over_baseline GROUP BY over_no ORDER BY over_no

SELECT to_char(match_date, 'DD Mon') AS "Date", stage AS "Stage", opponent AS "Opponent",
       score_for AS "Our score", score_against AS "Their score", result AS "Result", margin AS "Margin"
FROM cricket.match_log WHERE team = 'Astros+' AND season = 'Spring 2026' ORDER BY match_date
